## Guinness and YETI launch global partnership with limited-edition drinkware collection


## YETI x GUINNESS: ENJOY YOUR USUAL, SOMEWHERE NEW


YETI and GUINNESS announce global, three-year, multi-product partnership, beginning with a limited-edition premium drinkware range.


**LONDON, 17 NOVEMBER 2026:** Launching 17 November 2026, YETI and GUINNESS have come together to create a limited-edition premium drinkware collection designed to take great-quality GUINNESS beyond the familiar and into new and unexpected places and spaces.


The collection marks the first chapter of a three-year partnership between two iconic brands united by an uncompromising commitment to quality. YETI and GUINNESS also share a commitment to innovation and exceptional experiences. With exploration in their DNA, the new partnership brings together YETI’s expertise in premium outdoor drinkware with the world’s most iconic stout.


Today’s announcement builds on Diageo’s position as the number one alcohol licensor globally and one of the fastest growing players in FMCG licensing. 1


Licensing is an integral part of Guinness’s brand strategy, strengthening the perception of the brand amongst existing consumers and supporting the recruitment of new drinkers.


At the heart of the collection is the drinking experience. The two new YETI x GUINNESS Rambler® Tumblers and the YETI x GUINNESS Rambler® Mug feature double-wall vacuum insulation to maintain temperature and YETI’s DuraSip™ Ceramic Lining, specially designed to preserve taste quality while supporting the iconic head retention of a GUINNESS.


The collection pairs YETI’s durable design and functionality with unmistakable GUINNESS visual cues, creating premium drinking equipment designed for more social occasions and settings. Whether at a match-day watch party, a gathering with friends following an outdoor pursuit, a backyard BBQ-ing, or a festival campsite, YETI x GUINNESS is about making new GUINNESS moments possible.


**Bill Neff, Head of Marketing for YETI, commented:** “As a brand obsessed with creating premium gear that sets the standard for uncompromising design, performance and versatility, we’re thrilled to have the opportunity to collaborate with GUINNESS. The effort their team puts into ensuring every pint meets their strict quality standards is incredible, so to have their trust in our Rambler Drinkware to help deliver on that experience out in the wild is something we’re very proud of and excited to share.”


**Stephen O’Kelly, Guinness Global Brand Director, said:** “We’re always keen to explore new ways and places to enjoy GUINNESS. With YETI, we discovered a bold opportunity to take great GUINNESS experiences somewhere new. YETI and GUINNESS share an uncompromising commitment to quality and innovation. This partnership is particularly exciting as it uses YETI’s latest drinkware innovation to keep GUINNESS colder for longer and tasting its best wherever it’s enjoyed.”


Arriving in time for the holiday season, the limited-edition three-piece collection brings distinctive GUINNESS design together with YETI functionality to create a premium gift and collector’s item for fans of both brands.


**The YETI x GUINNESS collection includes:**
GUINNESS™ Beautiful Pour Rambler® 20 oz. Two-Tone Tumbler with DuraSip™ Ceramic Lining – $50 USD / £45/ €50
GUINNESS™ Harp Rambler® 20 oz. Tumbler with DuraSip™ Ceramic Lining – $50 USD / £45 / €50
GUINNESS™ Harp Rambler® 24 oz. Mug with DuraSip™ Ceramic Lining – $55 USD / £50 / €55
The YETI x GUINNESS collection goes on sale from 17 November 2026 via YETI.com, YETI® Stores and GUINNESS brand homes, while supplies last.

**ABOUT YETI**
Headquartered in Austin, Texas, YETI is a global designer, retailer, and distributor of innovative outdoor products. From coolers and drinkware to backpacks and bags, YETI products are built to meet the unique and varying needs of diverse outdoor pursuits, whether in the remote wilderness, at the beach, or anywhere life takes our customers. By consistently delivering high-performing, exceptional products, we have built a strong following of brand loyalists throughout the world, ranging from serious outdoor enthusiasts to individuals who simply value products of uncompromising quality and design. We have an unwavering commitment to outdoor and recreation communities, and we are relentless in our pursuit of building superior products for people to confidently enjoy life outdoors and beyond. For more information, please visit[www.YETI.com](https://www.yeti.com/) .


**ABOUT GUINNESS**
The GUINNESS Company was established in 1759, when Arthur Guinness signed a 9,000-year lease on St. James’s Gate Brewery in Dublin. Brewed using four natural ingredients – water, barley (malted & roasted), hops and yeast – GUINNESS is the world’s most popular stout. The iconic beer is brewed in 49 countries worldwide and sold in over 120. The most GUINNESS is sold in Great Britain, Ireland, USA, Nigeria and Cameroon. All GUINNESS consumed in Ireland and Great Britain is brewed at St. James’s Gate Brewery. More information can be found at[www.guinness.com](https://www.guinness.com/) . Enjoy GUINNESS Sensibly. Visit[www.drinkaware.ie](https://www.drinkaware.ie/)

Diageo is a global company, and our products are sold in nearly 180 countries around the world. The company is listed on both the London Stock Exchange (DGE) and the New York Stock Exchange (DEO).
